en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a general view of a coastal city with a long stone pier or jetty leading into a harbor. People walk along the pier, with mooring posts and lampposts on each side. Sailing ships are docked to the right, and a dense cluster of low-rise buildings stretches along the waterfront at the base of surrounding hills and mountains. A fortress or castle is visible on a hill overlooking the town. Red printed captions in Greek and French appear at the top, and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.
